description_en: Quick and accurate character detection in images from online scenarios such as E-commerce product promotional images, community forum images, and user-generated content (UGC) images
description_zh: 针对电商商品宣传图片、社区贴吧图片、网络UGC图片等网络场景下图片字符快速精准识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-basic --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/sdqwab/%E7%94%B5%E5%95%86%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --need-rotate false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBasic

parameters.description_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).

parameters.description_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
